'''November 2001 Melbourne tournament (25 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Melbourne, Australia on 25 November 2001. [[Luca Costanzo]] won it. It is known from Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3118">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-25-haakons-revenge-25-11-01-melb-ozd3118/ haakons-revenge-25-11-01-melb-oz], DeckTech (Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag, 25 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-25-haakons-revenge-25-11-01-melb-ozd3118/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Luca Costanzo]]
